name: macroscope
description: Macroscope local-first review for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first Macroscope review plus optional autopilot loop
interface.longDescription: Runs a streaming local Macroscope CLI review by default and supports an optional loop mode that pushes fixes, waits for correctness checks, and addresses PR comments until the branch is clean.
